note: 0.11 su-finish-11 barriers: CadCraft's starter Barriers types (Library kind type, category types/barriers). Sizes are ordinary product sizes in mm, chosen as usual examples; none is a code value and none was checked against a standard. bin/library-seed-barriers.php saves them as drafts (staff only); --publish is the owner's go at release.

types.name: Post and rail fence 1.2 m
types.description: Timber post and rail fence: three rails between square posts. Usual product sizes, not a code check; check local rules before you build.

types.name: Panel fence 1.8 m
types.description: Close-boarded panel fence: one solid panel between posts. Usual product sizes, not a code check; check local rules before you build.

types.name: Picket fence 1.0 m
types.description: Picket fence: pickets on two rails between posts. Usual product sizes, not a code check; check local rules before you build.

types.name: Chain-link fence 1.8 m
types.description: Chain-link mesh on round steel posts, drawn as a thin panel between posts. Usual product sizes, not a code check; check local rules before you build.

types.name: Glass panel guard 1070 mm
types.description: Guard with glass infill panels and a top rail. Usual product sizes, not a code check: guard height and openings are set by your building code.

types.name: Baluster guard 1070 mm
types.description: Guard with square balusters between a top and a bottom rail. Usual product sizes, not a code check: guard height and openings are set by your building code.

types.name: Round handrail 40 mm
types.description: Round wall-mounted handrail on brackets. Usual product sizes, not a code check: handrail height and grip size are set by your building code.

types.name: Rectangular timber handrail 60 mm
types.description: Rectangular timber handrail on brackets. Usual product sizes, not a code check: handrail height and grip size are set by your building code.

types.name: Steel baluster balustrade 1100 mm
types.description: Steel balustrade with round balusters and a flat top rail. Usual product sizes, not a code check: height and openings are set by your building code.

types.name: W-beam road guardrail
types.description: Steel W-beam guardrail on posts along a road. Usual product sizes, not a road safety check: road restraint systems are chosen and tested under your road authority's rules.

types.name: Thrie-beam road guardrail
types.description: Steel thrie-beam guardrail on posts along a road. Usual product sizes, not a road safety check: road restraint systems are chosen and tested under your road authority's rules.
